create_multihead_attention: create a multi-head attention module with configurable heads, embed dim, and attention type
build_mlp: build a multi-layer perceptron with configurable layers, hidden dim, dropout, and optional residual connections
run_multi_head_attention_forward: run multi-head attention forward pass with vanilla, xformer, or sparse attention types
create_dot_product_scoring: create a dot-product scoring module that projects queries and prompts to a shared projection space
summarize_sam3_output: summarize the SAM3Output class that provides iterable output with all steps, last step per stage, or flattened modes
